Title: Osney Bridge towpath diversion Oxford
Description: Towpath closed about 150 yards from bridge. Diversion via Abbey Road parallel to river. Botley Road closure work continuing into 2026, expected to complete Sept 2026.

Title: Sandford Footbridge closure Oxfordshire
Description: Unsafe footbridge north (upstream) of Sandford Lock closed by Environment Agency. Diversion via NCN 5 cycle route.

Title: Marsh Lock footbridge closure Henley
Description: Unsafe footbridge closed for safety. Diversion approx 3 miles via pavements on A4155. Order in force until 31 Jan 2026, may be extended.

Title: Abingdon Weir walkway closure
Description: Walkway across weir closed due to corrosion. Path re-routed via Abingdon town centre. Expected closure through 2026.

Title: Temple Footbridge closure near Marlow
Description: Bridge closed for foreseeable future due to structural safety concerns. Central span removed Nov 2025 for inspection. Diversion via Temple Lane and Bisham Abbey.

Title: Runnymede Bridge 142 closure Egham
Description: Bridge damaged in 2023 tree strike. Significant safety concerns identified. Path closed from just past Runnymede Hotel to before Staines. Diversion uses A308 pavements.

Title: Bell Weir Lock diversion Runnymede
Description: Small diversion at Runnymede Pleasure Grounds near Queen Elizabeth statue. Temporary diversion around construction compound for Bell Weir refurbishment works. Lock remains operational.

Title: Streatley-Goring towpath diversion
Description: Footpath Stre/24/1 closed to prevent danger whilst riverbank repairs planned. Ongoing closure, repairs hoped for next summer subject to funding.

Title: Penton Hook Island closure
Description: Island remains closed to public due to diseased trees posing high risk from falling branches. Public engagement held 20 March 2026. Specialist contractor working on remedial plan.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge Faringdon
Description: Bridge reconstruction completed 18 August 2026. Pedestrian crossing between Rushey and Shifford Locks now fully restored. Thames Path not directly affected as path runs on north bank.

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal disruption
Description: Path blocked on left bank of Grand Union Canal between bridge over River Brent and Brentford Marina. Redevelopment work ongoing. Partial reopening: walk down The Ham, cross canal at Thames Lock, follow Dock Road to High Street.

Title: Culham to Clifton Hampden diversion
Description: Path diverted along A415 for 2.2 miles whilst new bridge under construction west of railway viaduct. Signed diversion in place. Major ongoing works.

Title: Donnington Bridge to Isis Farmhouse diversion Oxford
Description: Towpath repairs between Donnington Bridge and Isis Farmhouse near Oxford. Short signed diversions in place. Closure for bank repairs, expected reopening November 2026.
